name: First Capital, Inc.
summary: First Capital, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for First Harrison Bank that provides various banking services to individuals and business customers in Indiana and Kentucky, the United States. The company provides various deposit instruments, including non-interest-bearing checking accounts, negotiable order of withdrawal accounts, money market accounts, regular savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and retirement savings plans. It also offers residential mortgage loans; construction loans for residential and commercial properties; and commercial real estate and business loans.
